caption: The drawing consists of a central bird with a long, curved neck and extended tail, positioned among an array of large, stylized flowers and leaves. The bird is predominantly pink and yellow, with red detailing and a spotted pattern along its body and tail. The background is a muted tan color, which is also the color of the unprinted areas. The flowers are illustrated in shades of pink, yellow, and red, with darker red accents outlining petals and leaves. Leafy branches, also rendered in red and brown hues, fill the spaces between the flowers and the bird, with smaller flower clusters and buds adding detail. The borders of the main image are clean, with the drawing framed by a plain, light tan margin.
title: Chintz
